# TypeFerry

> TypeFerry is a type-safe, real-time RPC framework. This index routes AI agents building consumer applications to concise, authoritative Markdown documentation.

Use the TypeScript application guide first for consumer work. The wire protocol
is normative only for protocol-visible behavior. Repository-maintainer agent
instructions are separate from application guidance.

## Application development

- [Application framework](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/application-framework.md): Canonical commands, conventions, configuration, migration, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
- [AI agent application guide](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/agents/application-development.md): Supported structure, public imports, commands, configuration, implementation workflow, safety boundaries, and completion checks.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Run the canonical React and MongoDB template.
- [Application template](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/template/README.md): Executable consumer application and production workflow.
- [TypeScript package](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/typeferry-ts/README.md): Published package entry points and API overview.

## TypeScript features

- [Server and RPC](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/server-rpc.md): Server lifecycle, namespaces, methods, validation, protection, and caching.
- [Client](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/client.md): Framework-agnostic HTTP and WebSocket client.
- [React](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/react.md): Provider, hooks, RPC state, and subscriptions.
- [Authentication](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/authentication.md): Context, sessions, cookies, OAuth, and security boundaries.
- [Events and channels](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/events-and-channels.md): Real-time publication and invalidation patterns.
- [MongoDB](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/mongodb.md): Typed collections, schemas, and live invalidation.
- [EJSON](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/ejson.md): Extended wire-safe value serialization.
- [Deployment](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/typescript/deployment.md): Production build and operational checklist.

## Contracts

- [Application framework conventions](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/architecture/application-framework-toolchain.md): Framework-owned commands, defaults, configuration, and boundaries.
- [Wire protocol](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/PROTOCOL.md): Normative cross-language protocol.
- [Documentation home](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/README.md): Complete documentation map, including Python and Rust servers.

## Optional maintainer context

- [Repository agent router](https://github.com/leonardoventurini/typeferry/blob/main/docs/agents/README.md): Use only when changing TypeFerry itself, not a consumer application.
